Assistant
Helps you create a video from a prompt, file, or link. You describe the topic and it generates the script and visuals. You can also refine it with chat. 
Canvas view
Your main editing space. You design each scene - add avatars, text, images, and layout. 
Storyboard view
Shows your full script in one place so you can review and edit it easily.
Timeline view
Lets you fine-tune timing, animations, and layers for more precise control.
Elements
Things you add to scenes: avatars, text, shapes, images, captions, recordings, and more. 
Delivery style
Choose cinematic (fast, dynamic) or presentation (longer, denser scenes). 
That’s basically: generate → edit scenes → fine-tune timing → add visuals 👍
